LESSON: DRIVING TOOLS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Tools and Production
Topic 4.2: Driving Tools

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Driving Tools. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Driving Tools
2. Practise Driving Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Driving Tools

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Driving Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Driving Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Driving Tools at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Driving Tools at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Driving Tools
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Driving Tools. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Driving Tools using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Driving Tools in the examples.
2. Explain Driving Tools to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Driving Tools.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Driving Tools using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Driving Tools important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Driving Tools
2. Practise Driving Tools at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Driving Tools

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
